recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Make any future primitive validator example changes in FHIR/fhir-test-cases; update core only if the downloads page stops pointing to the active external test-case releases or the work group decides to repatriate validator test cases into the core spec checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-12960 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core datatypes request to add negative primitive datatype examples so developers could test primitive datatype validation behavior. Its resolution was to expand build\tests\validation-examples with invalid datatype instances available through the downloads-page test cases.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12461. In git, ffb483245175ff499a837bc605277a047ffa7b12 has the matching git-svn-id build@12461 and added tests/validation-examples/primitive-good.xml and tests/validation-examples/primitive-bad.xml for FHIR-12960 and FHIR-12959.
additional_context: The current core checkout no longer owns that validation-examples corpus: 39393f8f1db76ed75643b2926278944c03cfae40 deleted it as moved to java core, 3fd6994c06dfa6b80ab93eccd87f9c8642f6dd0d updated downloads.html to an external test-case location, and current source/downloads.html points to FHIR/fhir-test-cases releases. FHIR/fhir-test-cases currently contains validator/primitive-bad.xml, validator/primitive-good.xml, and related primitive validator files.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because restoring tests/validation-examples would duplicate a deliberately migrated, externally owned test corpus, while the current downloads page already points implementers to the repository containing the requested negative examples.

related_jiras.note: The same svn/git application commit handled a related Published/Persuasive primitive regex documentation/source request, but that issue has a separate primitive-regex reconciliation scope.
A later AutoFHIR audit cited the same 2017 primitive work as context for dateTime schema regex history; it does not change the FHIR-12960 test-case migration decision.
